definitions.explanation: The hottest period of summer, typically referring to July and August in Japan. A somewhat literary or formal word for the peak of the summer season.

examples.japanese: {盛夏|せいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}、⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧お⟦{過|す}ごし→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: In this midsummer season, how are you doing?
examples.notes: A formal seasonal greeting used in letters.

examples.japanese: {盛夏|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三十五度|さんじゅうごど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: With midsummer upon us, temperatures exceeding 35 degrees have continued.

examples.japanese: {盛夏|せいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
Literary and formal. Its main home is the seasonal greeting at the start of a letter ({時候|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧): {盛夏|せいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}, used from mid-July into August. Also {盛夏|せいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ in news and business writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧: midsummer — the everyday word
- ⟦{晩夏|ばんか}→晩夏：19623_banka⟧: late summer — the formal counterpart for the end of the season

WATCH OUT:
Homophones: ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧ (result), ⟦{聖火|せいか}→聖火：16179_seika⟧ (Olympic flame), ⟦{製菓|せいか}→製菓：14090_seika⟧ (confectionery).
